versions.changelog:
Initial release of google-sheets-fdds-report.

- Enables reading FDDS metrics from a specified Google Sheets document.
- Compares performance metrics from the latest available day (D-1) with the same day of the previous week (W-1).
- Extracts key indicators: % FDDS, delivery failures, shipment counts, and detailed failure breakdowns.
- Generates or updates a report template based on these comparisons.
